owner: Noosa Council / OneQode Assets Pty Ltd lease
notes: Noosa Council minutes record the Cooroy Data Centre premises at 11A Maple Street, Cooroy and council agreement to enter a commercial lease with OneQode Assets Pty Ltd, plus an associated wireless internet mast licence. Earlier council agenda material indicates the 97 sqm facility was constructed in 2008 under the Clever Networks project with fibre, electrical, cooling and fire services.
